maxTurnRateDegS.note: Planning factor: coordinated-turn rate g tan(bank) / V. The 45° roll limit is the ArduPlane default (ROLL_LIMIT_DEG 45; PX4 FW_R_LIM 50°), the autopilot class these small fixed-wing UAS fly with. At the record's cruise speed 30 m/s: 19°/s. No turn rate, bank limit or g limit is published for this airframe.

climbRateMps.note: Planning factor: No Orlan-10 source publishes no climb rate. The ArduPlane TECS_CLMB_MAX default and the PX4 FW_T_CLMB_MAX default are both 5.0 m/s for a small fixed-wing UAS.

maxAccelMps2.note: Planning factor: No Orlan-10 source publishes no acceleration. MTOW 15 to 16.5 kg on a small petrol engine (Wikipedia; Airforce Technology). A propeller airframe with thrust-to-weight near 0.3 and cruise drag near 0.1 of weight accelerates at about 0.2 g = 2 m/s² in level flight.

radiatedPowerW.note: Planning factor: No Orlan-10 source publishes no link power. Orlan-10 commands at 850 to 930 MHz and downlinks payload at 3, 4 and 8 GHz, with 3G/4G for imagery on some payloads (Wikipedia; Armada International). The only OEM-published link power in this threat set is Mugin's SprintLink family (2 W, 5 W, 10 W at 1.4 GHz for 30 to 150 km); the 2 W entry-level class is used for a small-UAS command and video link.
